prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the side impact damage shows a crushed rear quarter panel, a cracked taillight housing, and a bent rear door frame, all consistent with the reported intersection collision. The pattern and location of the deformation match the described angle of contact. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the repair plan calls for replacing the quarter panel, straightening the door frame, refinishing the affected panels, and replacing the lamp assembly. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this work. Billing reviewed to date shows no repeated charges for the same operations.
